evidence.quote: But it was also evident that capital requirements had simply been set too low in general, and with respect to particular assets.

While there continues to be a relatively high degree of uncertainty about near- to medium-term economic prospects, the basic questions surrounding capital and regulatory reform have now been answered.
I can say that our approach to considering such requests will be a conservative one.
This simply is not a good outcome from any broad perspective--not for the revival of housing markets
